P1.title: Residue-order / peptide-adjacency contract
P1.verdict_impact: Fixes fabricated peptide re-pairing for insertion-coded residues (e.g. 1PPE 184A/184). May change LAW-110/120/125/135/160 observations for such deposits; no threshold definitions changed. No false veto is silenced; the ordering is corrected to source order.
P1.acceptance: get_sequential_residues and Tier1Measurements._extract order by authoritative sequence position (label_seq_id when valid else res_seq) with a stable sort; source order preserved for same-position residues; full backend suite green.

P2.title: Source-backed coverage denominator
P2.verdict_impact: LAW-105 coverage denominator now uses the authoritative polymer sequence (SEQRES / entity_poly_seq) when available, including positions absent from coordinates. When the source sequence cannot be established, LAW-105 fails closed (MEASUREMENT_FAILED, observed=None) instead of claiming observed-only 100%. The returned coverage (used by adjudicator/API/evaluator/PDF) matches the LAW-105 source-backed value. Structures whose source sequence equals observed coordinates report identical coverage to before; structures with unresolved positions now report reduced coverage. Verdict may change for inputs with missing sequence positions; no threshold changed.
P2.acceptance: LAW-105 reports coverage_basis (source_polymer_sequence vs source_polymer_sequence_unavailable), numerator, denominator, source_sequence_available, and per-chain source counts. Missing source sequence fails closed. Full backend suite green.

P3.title: LAW-130 boundary / MEASUREMENT_FAILED tests
P3.verdict_impact: LAW-130 observation-precision contract fixed: the reported value is round(raw,2) and the canonical '<=' threshold is applied to that same reported value, so displayed value and status can never contradict. On neighbor-search failure, sample is now 0 (a tooling failure is not a measurement) and the input atom count is exposed separately as input_atom_count. Verdict behavior for a pure tooling failure is unchanged (MEASUREMENT_FAILED -> INDETERMINATE); boundary semantics pinned (<10 PASS, =20 PASS, >20 VETO). No threshold changed.
P3.acceptance: LAW-130 boundary (<=), MEASUREMENT_FAILED on neighbor-search failure, sample=0 with separate input_atom_count, and reported-value/status consistency all pinned. Full backend suite green.

P4.title: LAW-182 advisory end-to-end
P4.verdict_impact: LAW-182 is confirmed heuristic/advisory (non-blocking). Added negative controls proving an adverse LAW-182 alone never vetoes, never enters deterministic blocking laws, and serializes as FAIL (Advisory); deterministic failures still veto. Missing LAW-182 stays NOT_MEASURED (not favorable). API response exposes method=heuristic and advisory status; PDF labels heuristic/advisory (existing PDF logic verified through the API ingest path). No threshold/classification changed; behavior pinned by tests.
P4.acceptance: Adverse LAW-182 alone never vetoes; absent from deterministic blocking; API/PDF label advisory; missing measurement honest; deterministic failures still veto. Full backend suite green.

P5.title: LAW-155 advisory restoration
P5.verdict_impact: LAW-155 reclassified from retired to heuristic/advisory (D3/Part-16 D6). It no longer appears in RETIRED_LAWS; adverse LAW-155 now serializes as FAIL (Advisory) and never produces a deterministic VETO; missing measurement stays NOT_MEASURED. Canon hash updated (method classification included in compute_canon_hash) and hash locks re-pinned: law_registry.sha256 old 81b57f4c... -> new 8f21ccb4...; law_semantic.sha256 old d2b3b850... -> new f825f38b...; canon hash old f24ec581b3e04732 -> new 6a9cd4b4349b81de. LAW-155 threshold/meaning unchanged; unrelated law semantics verified unchanged by tests.
P5.acceptance: LAW-155 advisory-only non-blocking end-to-end (adjudicator + API + PDF); hash locks re-pinned with old/new digests recorded in register Part-16 D6; unrelated law semantics unchanged; full backend suite green.

rollback: The P1 change is confined to backend/tos/engine/coord_math.py, tier1_measurements.py, ingestion/{processor,atom_selection}.py, and a new test file. Reverting those four source edits restores prior ordering behavior; the new test file can be removed. No data migration, hash-lock change, or law-semantic change is introduced by P1.
